schema_note: 候选扩容记录，不进入正式 d2d/ir。来源为 RM-MPU-6000A-00 Revision 4.2 的本地 PDF 镜像，已与 InvenSense/TDK 官方网页索引的文档号、版本、日期和关键页内容对齐；镜像来源仍需第二位审校者确认后才可准入。

i2c.note: 7-bit address b110100X; AD0 selects LSB; Product Specification p.33

source_evidence: RM-MPU-6000A-00 Revision 4.2, 46-page local mirror; register map p.6-8, CONFIG p.13, GYRO_CONFIG p.14, accelerometer outputs p.29, WHO_AM_I p.45. Official web index confirms the same document number, revision and release date.

registers.name: SMPLRT_DIV
registers.desc: Sample-rate divider; official register map p.8 and detailed description

fields.name: SMPLRT_DIV
fields.desc: Sample Rate = gyroscope output rate / (1 + divider)

registers.name: CONFIG
registers.desc: FSYNC sampling and digital low-pass filter; official map p.8 and description

registers.name: GYRO_CONFIG
registers.desc: Gyroscope self-test and full-scale selection; official map p.8 and detailed description

registers.name: ACCEL_CONFIG
registers.desc: Accelerometer self-test and full-scale selection; official map p.8

registers.name: ACCEL_XOUT_H
registers.desc: High byte of 16-bit X accelerometer measurement; official p.29

registers.name: ACCEL_XOUT_L
registers.desc: Low byte of 16-bit X accelerometer measurement; official p.29

registers.name: ACCEL_YOUT_H
registers.desc: High byte of 16-bit Y accelerometer measurement; official p.29

registers.name: ACCEL_YOUT_L
registers.desc: Low byte of 16-bit Y accelerometer measurement; official p.29

registers.name: ACCEL_ZOUT_H
registers.desc: High byte of 16-bit Z accelerometer measurement; official p.29

registers.name: PWR_MGMT_1
registers.desc: Power, sleep, temperature and clock control; official map p.8. Non-zero reset.

fields.name: DEVICE_RESET
fields.desc: Device reset control; auto-clears to 0 after whole-device reset (register detail pp.40-41)

registers.name: WHO_AM_I
registers.desc: Device identity; official p.45. Bits 7 and 0 are hard-coded zero.

fields.name: WHO_AM_I
fields.desc: Upper six bits of 7-bit I2C address

excluded_blocks: FIFO, interrupt, auxiliary-I2C and dynamic gyro/temperature registers remain excluded until their stateful read/write semantics are reviewed.
I2C electrical waveform timing is recorded as metadata; the direct-register harness does not score bus-level ACK/START/STOP behavior.
DEVICE_RESET whole-device side effects are documented but not independently asserted by the direct-register harness.

proofread_record.method: Product Specification pp.30-36 plus 46-page RM-MPU-6000A-00 Revision 4.2 local mirror and official web index
proofread_record.erratum_found: not checked by an independent reviewer
open_questions: Independent review passed after adding reserved fields, correcting PWR_MGMT_1 page references, and recording primary-I2C framing metadata.

address_encoding.write_sequence: START -> AD+W -> ACK -> RA -> ACK -> DATA bytes -> ACK -> STOP
address_encoding.read_sequence: START -> AD+W -> ACK -> RA -> ACK -> repeated START -> AD+R -> ACK/DATA -> NACK -> STOP
